page.layout: One printed page, title page; all lines centred in one column; a rule above and below a central woodcut vignette (oval seal). No notes.

main_text.l: [vignette: oval seal with the legend "HIC · LVCE MORT · POCVLA · SACRA" around "Alma Mater"]

page.notes: The oval seal's legend is partly worn; the reading "HIC · LVCE MORT · POCVLA · SACRA" is approximate. The vignette shows the words "Alma Mater" in its centre. The first line is set in italic script; "Amesii" is in a large italic with a swash A.
